assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before any statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for the provided provisional boundaries and design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (agent-derived from announcement four-to text and ~11.4 km² text area); they are not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios are reported from the submitted provisional geometry in EPSG:4548 and must be recomputed when the organizer publishes official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Approved floor area ratio, building heights, development intensity, and street/rail alignment are not present in the public site package and are recorded as unknown.
assumptions.impact: Concept design quantity (building footprint, block massing, corridors) is indicative only and is never presented as a statutory control.

assumptions.statement: All '呼号站 / call station', '听阈广场 / listening plaza', sound-zone, and calling-protocol spatial proposals are concept suggestions or reference schemes for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved construction or government decisions.
assumptions.impact: Spatial placement of call stations, plazas, and sound corridors is indicative and subject to site, heritage, and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Soundscape zoning, noise budgets, and night quiet-hours protocols are design directions grounded in public acoustic/environmental health practice; measured values require on-site surveys and official environmental data.
assumptions.impact: No quantitative decibel claims are made beyond general public-health framing; all sound budgets are labeled as concept and to-be-validated.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer-community operations, scenario open-operation, and international conversion mechanisms are concept operational directions for organizers to deepen, not confirmed government arrangements or commitments.
assumptions.impact: Event calendars, community programs, and conversion targets are proposals, not commitments or performance guarantees.

assumptions.statement: The proposal follows bilingual contract v1: proposal.md (zh) and proposal.en.md (en) are aligned in sections, claims, metrics, evidence references, and figure placement; all text-bearing display artifacts carry en counterparts.
assumptions.impact: Bilingual packaging satisfies the blocking language gate.
